name: bws-mcp
description: Bitwarden Secrets Manager MCP over a Cloudflare Worker URL

interface.shortDescription: Bitwarden Secrets Manager MCP over a Cloudflare Worker URL
interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to a bws-mcp Cloudflare Worker. Tools list, get, create or update, and delete secrets in one allowlisted project at a time. Set the HTTP url in .mcp.json to your Worker origin plus /mcp after you deploy. There is no plugin setup field for that URL.
interface.defaultPrompt: List secret names in the prod project through bws-mcp.
